title: "Could not contact service /controller_manager/list_controllers" in ros2_control: robot_description, the Humble remap, namespaces, timeouts and use_sim_time, measured
excerpt: Why the ros2_control spawner can't reach a running controller manager: it offers no services until it gets a URDF. The Humble ~/robot_description remap, the parameter Jazzy and Lyrical ignore, namespaces, -c, timeouts and use_sim_time, measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
